result.summary: PASS. git diff --name-only main...HEAD shows exactly the expected files: test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs plus this run's own handoff/design docs -- lib/letflow/platform/migration_rollout.ex is untouched, matching the design's 'no production-code change' scope. EO-004's replacement (lines 384-409) matches design SS2.2 verbatim: independent Repo.all query of every Outcome for first_result.rollout.id, an Enum.all?/2 check that every one is 'succeeded', and the two-branch assertion (completed/non-nil completed_at vs running/nil completed_at) -- no hardcoded literal, no filtering-away of swept-in tenants. EO-005's three replacements (lines 433-434, 466-467/474, 459-460) match design SS3.1/3.2/3.3: outcome_for/2-scoped success checks for good_a/good_b instead of the removed blanket first_result.outcomes check; a direct Repo.get!(Rollout, id) reload-and-equality-compare replacing the global Rollout count, and an Outcome count query scoped to rollout_id AND tenant_id in [good_a, good_b] replacing the global Outcome count; outcome_for/2-scoped already_current checks replacing the removed blanket second_result.outcomes check. Idiom: outcome_for/2 used consistently with the file's ISS-0716 precedent (lines 315-316), Ecto queries use the same from/Repo.aggregate/Repo.get! style already established in the file (e.g. the queryable-outcome-record test at lines 288-327), no new helpers or abstractions introduced -- straight assertion-level changes only, no scope creep. Comments at each changed assertion correctly cite the design doc and explain the race, consistent with the file's existing comment style (e.g. the ISS-0716 note at lines 303-308). Ran `mix test test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs` directly: 'Finished in 12.2 seconds (0.00s async, 12.2s sync) / Result: 12 passed', 0 failures. No issues found; no rework needed.
